author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up from author: Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'm surprised by the amount of people who are interested. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works. Contact: comment on the post or DM @blekek.k.

author: Tee Yuan Xin
title: Freelance graphic designer for client visuals
content: Looking for a Freelance Graphic Designer. Currently looking for someone who can support us on upcoming client projects, mainly for: Social media visuals; Ads creatives; Campaign posters; Simple visual adaptations / resizing. Prefer someone who has a good eye for clean & modern design, can follow brand guidelines / references well, is responsive and able to meet deadlines, and is comfortable handling ad & social media creatives. Author follow-up: This will be freelance / project-based, with potential for more ongoing projects if we work well together. If you're interested, drop your portfolio + rate in the comments or DM me. Contact: comment or DM @yuanxin_289.
